audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault is described only as a 'block' that eats Q poke. The channel property and the front-only limitation are absent, and Grand Starfall is called 'Grand Skyfall' in three places.
audit.why: Aegis Assault is a channel (22/21/20/19/18s) that makes him invulnerable to damage from the front — CC cancels it outright, so Pyromania or Tibbers ends it, and damage from behind is not blocked at all. The ultimate is Grand Starfall (180/165/150s, 5500 range).
audit.corrected: Stun or Tibbers through Aegis Assault to cancel it; never poke into its face; call the ultimate Grand Starfall.
sources: brief enemyKit E/R text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault's auto-attack reset is never mentioned.
audit.why: The W carries an autoReset flag — the wind-up, not the spell cast, is the tell that the all-in has started.
audit.corrected: Read the auto wind-up as the engage cue.

edits.before: Your first item spike lets you consistently win the burst race against Pantheon as long as you dodge or bait his Shield Vault stun first — his kit has no shield or hard escape to survive a landed combo. A fed Pantheon becomes a genuine threat through his Comet Spear poke and repeated ultimate roams that snowball other lanes, so ward his likely roam paths and don't let him accumulate a gold lead unanswered.

notes: Packet flagged three suspect names; two were false positives (Aegis Assault is correct) and one was real — 'Grand Skyfall' appeared in spikes[1].text, mid and wants.foe[2] and is Grand Starfall. Separate factual error in `late`: it claimed Pantheon 'has no shield', which is wrong — Aegis Assault is a shield channel that makes him invulnerable from the front. The useful correction is that it is a channel any CC cancels and that it protects only the front. Level chart disagreed on all seven rows between layers; content matches packet.levelChart, so the full layer was flipped wholesale as one group. Note phases[0..3].rating stays 7/10 while the side flips to Skill/Annie — rating reads as difficulty rather than ownership, so I left it, but flag if the applier treats rating as part of the chart group.
